Identify the single year that meets these interlinked criteria: (1) It is the year a specific national heritage protection law was enacted, which—as of the early 2020s—is formally slated to be replaced by new environmental legislation drafted by a certain government ministry; (2) That same ministry produced an official report with an alphanumeric code covering a two-year span ending exactly one year before a major global sporting event held in East Asia; (3) In that very same year, a landmark medical procedure—the world's first successful human birth using a reproductive technology that would later become standard—was achieved by a research team whose lead physician shares the same surname as a prominent 20th-century physicist awarded a Nobel Prize in the same decade the law was enacted.
